Firefighters Act in Time to Prevent Major Loss in Shed Fire

By Kevin Zimmermann Aug 8, 2026 | 8:50 AM

Sheboygan Cty Sheriff's Dept - photo courtesy of Mark Heitman

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 0:45
Instaread

No major loss was noted after a shed fire in the Town of Greenbush erupted on Friday night.  The Sheboygan County Emergency Communications Center was called around 10:47 PM with reports of the fire in a detached shed on Forest Drive in the Town of Greenbush west of the Kettle Moraine Correctional Institution.

Arriving Sheboygan County deputies encountered a large detached three-car shed on fire, and multiple responding departments were able to control the blaze with no major property lost and no injuries reported.

The cause of that fire is under investigation.
